{{Infobox character|name=Kael Ashbourne|house=[[House Ashbourne]]|role=Heir|age=~26|kin=[[Roderick Ashbourne]] (father), [[Isolde Ashbourne]] (sister)|words=We land where we dare.}}
'''Kael Ashbourne''' is the heir of [[House Ashbourne]] — everything his father once was. His own [[The Leap|Leap]], at nineteen, was a ride against a bandit camp no one had asked him to touch: fast, bloody, celebrated. Two of his own died. He carved their names into the Wall of Names with his own hand.

His certainty is warm and infectious; he speaks in commands, despises conditional clauses, and stands facing east when he thinks — toward the mountains, the unknown. He dreams openly of a Leap eastward, across [[the Silent Mountains]], to where no one has returned.

{{Quote|We don't lose because we're too few. We lose the day we stand still and count.|Kael Ashbourne}}
